items.title: Citigroup (C) Takes On A Bigger Role In Leveraged ETF Risk
items.summary: Citigroup is taking a larger role in managing risks tied to leveraged ETFs, including the use of complex "crash put" options to hedge exposures. The bank is also highlighted as a key player in discussions about a possible entry of the US Treasury into the repo market. Both developments raise questions for financial stability and could influence how Citigroup funds and protects its trading activities.
